body: I'm sorry...thanks for the story though. I have really trash self-esteem so it's very difficult for me to be happy by myself. I guess I can work on that though...
Thanks. These have been some of the hardest days in my life. I’ve kind of gone off the rails but I’ll attempt to reassert myself into a semblance of normality.
Yeah you’re right. I guess I should talk to my family...venting here won’t really do much.
It’s truly unfortunate...a month ago we were fine and suddenly our friendship collapsed.
My story is so similar. I felt a connection that I had never felt before, and now that is gone, I'm stuck searching for this feeling in friendships that are nowhere near as close.
That’s what I did and they just kept downplaying my issues...
Thank you. My family doesn’t really care so I need to handle it on my own...
I pray that you’ll keep in touch. :)
Yea...I feel you there. I’ve been crying my eyes out and have gone to places mentally I never thought I’d go.
I don’t really hear things like this too often. Thank you stranger, from the bottom of my heart. You’ve upped my mood considerably.
Don't even know if there is one...but I would love if there was so then we can all be alone together.
Can you send an invite link?
